prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 26 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1468; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with complaints of neck pain and restricted cervical range of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the forces expected in a crash of this type, and the presenting symptoms align with a cervical strain. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the soft tissue injury to the neck. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body region is known to this office. Over the course of care, the patient completed 26 visits, which is somewhat longer than typical for this diagnosis. Treatment included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, with gradual improvement in range of motion and pain levels. Billing records reflect single entries for each service rendered, with no repeated charges for the same service on the same date. Current status is improved, with residual stiffness reported on prolonged neck flexion. Further follow-up will be arranged as needed.
